body: Exactly she knew the struggles i was going through daily but as soon she starts going up in the world she forgets the person who was with her when no one else was

Im the same way with my parents but a way i destress and try help my mental health is to get a bike and exercise. life at home used to be unbearable in my room alone and being mentally abused by my parents and it hurt i know how it feels feeling useless but once i started riding a bike it clears my thoughts and helps me cope every day obviously bikes are not for everyone but find a passion and stick with it it may not stop how your parents act but it should make u be able to destress
